text:
sam: FYI i'm putting together the internal RN/blast for Monday's maintenance window (11:00-11:30 PT). small runtime patch + bugfixes, but want an explicit hold vs broadcast checklist.
ivy: thanks. can you include the exact deploybot id and the quick rollback CLI? keeps comms actionable.
sam: yes. draft TL;DR: 
```
- Deploy runtime v2.4.2 (KV cache fixes, batching improvement)
- Canary: 3% for 15m -> 20% for 20m -> 100%
- No user-facing schema changes expected
```
alon: ops notes: add automated abort threshold: p95 > 220ms OR 5xx > 0.4% over 5m. if triggered, stop canary and fallback to pinned variant v2.3.1.
ivy: i'll write two announce variants: (A) hold (if canary fails), (B) broadcast (if canary passes). who should be on the short owners list in the blast?
sam: owners: SRE (@tilly), Runtime (@alon), Product (@prod-comm). include contact runbook link.
tilly: I'll be oncall for the window. monitoring plan: 1m/5m p95, 5xx rate, token-cost-per-request. alert tiers: warn p95>150ms, critical p95>220ms.
deploybot: "queued deploy id db-20250302-7 by sam at 2025-03-02T18:00:00Z (11:00 PT). canary policy: 3% -> 20% -> 100%. notify: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime"
alon: rollback CLI snippet (put in RN):
```
# quick abort and revert
deploybot cancel --id db-20250302-7 --reason "canary regression"
# pin fallback variant from console CLI
redwood console pin model my-model --version v2.3.1 --force
```
ivy: internal announce first-pass (hold and broadcast templates):
HOLD (if canary fails):
"Team — scheduled runtime deploy v2.4.2 at 11:00 PT. Canary failed safety checks. We are pausing and rolling back to v2.3.1. SRE lead: @tilly. See runbook: internal/release/db-20250302-7. Reply here for status."
BROADCAST (if canary OK):
"Team — runtime v2.4.2 deployed. Canary passed; ramping to 100% at T+35m. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token cost. SRE lead: @tilly. Full release notes: docs/releases/2025-03-02."
sam: also include a tiny bulleted checklist for the person posting:
- confirm canary metrics OK for 20m
- post BROADCAST template to #eng-releases and #all-hands T+5m
- update release notes link in deploy ticket
- mark deploy ticket DONE
tilly: preflight i'll run 20m before: health=green, canary pods 5x, smoke load 60 qps for 30s, kv cache primed. i'll post preflight OK here.
alon: note on quality regressions: prefer pin-to-v2.3.1 rather than full cluster restart to avoid cold starts. add that policy sentence.
ivy: adding the rollback CLI, console pin steps, owners, runbook link, and the poster checklist to both templates.
deploybot: "deploy db-20250302-7 scheduled. runbook attached: internal/release/db-20250302-7"
sam: last ask — can someone add the release notes link to docs/snippets and request a short blurb from Product for the public-facing release note?
prod-comm: will provide a 2-line public blurb by EOD and drop it into docs/releases/2025-03-02.
ivy: i'll finalize the two paste-ready blocks and post for review in 8m. who will actually hit the broadcast button?
sam: ivy will post if BROADCAST; if HOLD, tilly will post the hold message.
tilly: yep. i'll also pin the runbook to the deploy ticket after rollback/pin action.
sam: great. summary: draft RN + two announce variants in progress, rollback CLI + console pin included, SRE standby confirmed, deploybot queued. reconvene 15m before window for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
